title: Terms of service
lead: These terms describe what Smallfold does, who can apply, what it costs and what each side decides.
draftNotice: These terms are a draft. Smallfold is not a registered business yet, and the owner or a lawyer must check this page before the site goes public.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Smallfold finds sponsors for small YouTube channels. Smallfold is not a registered business yet. Its legal name is <mark class="blank">(legal name to be added)</mark> and it is based in <mark class="blank">(country to be added)</mark>.
In these terms, “we” means Smallfold. A “creator” is a person who applies with a YouTube channel. A “sponsor” is a brand that wants to sponsor a channel.

sections.heading: What we do
paragraphs: A person looks at each channel and chooses a sponsor that suits it. We suggest the sponsor to the creator and the channel to the sponsor. For now we work with YouTube channels only.
We do not promise to find a sponsor for every channel, or a channel for every sponsor.

sections.heading: Who can apply
paragraphs: A creator can apply with a YouTube channel that has 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers. A channel with fewer than 1,000 subscribers cannot join yet.
Applying is free, and joining is free. We reply to an application within 2 working days.
The details in an application or a brand inquiry must be true, including the subscriber count.

sections.heading: Who decides
paragraphs: A creator can turn down any sponsor we suggest. A sponsor approves each channel we suggest to it. A deal goes ahead only when the creator and the sponsor both agree.
How each deal is agreed and put in writing is <mark class="blank">(deal agreement to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: Commission
paragraphs: We charge a commission only once a deal is done. The commission is taken from the creator’s fee. If there is no deal, there is no commission.
The rate depends on the size of the sponsorship. It is 10% under $500, 8% from $500 to $1,999, and 5% at $2,000 or more.
The sponsor pays exactly the agreed fee and nothing extra.
How and when payments are made is <mark class="blank">(payment terms to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: Our responsibility
paragraphs: What we are responsible for, and the limits of that responsibility, are <mark class="blank">(limits of liability to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may change these terms. The date at the top of this page shows when they were last changed.
